sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Seven questions a healthcare team asked before real patient data went into sgit vaults, answered.
sections.para: And QR codes for passing keys and links.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Good questions; no live date; your region; erasure works; lose the key, lose the vault; tokens; QR codes.

sections.label: The questions
sections.line: A team designing patient vaults with invented data asked before using any real data.

sections.label: 1. When will the doctor console be live?
sections.line: No date: test on dev with invented data, and run your own server at the version you tested.
sections.para: Then the live date is yours.

sections.label: 2. Which address should patients use?
sections.line: The patient's details live in their own vault, opened from a link the clinic gives them.
sections.para: Ideally sealed to their key, as a QR code.

sections.label: 3. Where are the vaults stored?
sections.line: Whichever region you choose, in your own AWS account; the host holds ciphertext only.

sections.label: 4. How is a request to erase handled?
sections.line: A deleted vault is removed and its id can never be uploaded again; without a key, copies are unreadable.
sections.para: Deletion stops future access, not past copies.

sections.label: 5. What if the clinic's key is lost?
sections.line: Lose the clinic key, lose the vaults: seal it to custodians, keep an offline QR copy, rotate on departures.

sections.label: 6. Per-patient access tokens?
sections.line: The server token only authorises uploads; changes need the vault key and identity.

sections.label: 7. Writing to a vault from another site
sections.line: Append lanes: write-only, per sender, sealed to the clinic's key, from any page.

sections.label: QR codes, and how this scales
sections.line: Public keys swapped by QR code, vault links sealed to a patient's key, the clinic key backed up sealed.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: No live date; not legal advice; lane routes on dev when documented; deletion is not retroactive.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The team's questions, my answers, sgit.ai docs, the deploy guides and pki.sgit.ai.
